verses.1: Do not rejoice, Israel! Do not be like other nations, who have sinned against your God. You have loved us for all our sins.
verses.2: The branches and leaves will not be destroyed, and the fruit will remain intact.
verses.3: They shall not dwell in the land of Jehovah. Ephraim will return from Egypt, but in Assyria they will be destroyed.
verses.4: They shall not defy Jehovah. They shall not offer him their sacrifices or give him any gifts. All their offerings will be rejected, just as if they had given blood sacrifices to their own souls. The house of Jehovah will not be entered into.
verses.5: What will they do on the day of celebration and on the day of Jehovah’s festival?
verses.6: For behold, they went from the land of Egypt. They were brought out as slaves, and they were given food to eat. Then they stood up and inherited their lands.
verses.7: The days of trouble have come. The days of destruction have arrived. Israel will know that the prophet is a fool, and that the man of heaven is full of lies.
verses.8: May Ephraim be blessed with the help of the prophet Pach Yakosh, who will guide him along all his paths. May he be seated in the house of God.
verses.9: They will be deeply ashamed in those days of judgment. They will remember their sins and be punished for them.
verses.10: Like grapes in a desert, I found Israel as a “covenant” at its beginning. I saw your ancestors who came with empty hands; they were like those who were sent away from their homes. They became like those who were left behind, lost in the wilderness.
verses.11: Ephraim will be scattered far away from its land, from its hills and from its valleys.
verses.12: For if they raise their children up and make them wise from among men, then there will still be evil in their midst.
verses.13: Ephraim, when I saw it as a place of destruction and ruin. Ephraim, that was used to bring forth its own destruction.
verses.14: Let the Lord give them what they deserve. Let him show them compassion and kindness.
verses.15: All their evil deeds are in vain, for there they hate each other. They hate those who are worse than them. I will not accept their love; all their words are empty promises.
verses.16: Their roots will be destroyed, and they will no longer bear fruit. Even when they are born and die, their bodies will remain useless.
verses.17: May the Lord be angry because they did not listen to him. They will be taken captive in other countries.
